question.content: My app PM-MH-100 is approved. Tell me the status of my first and second installments.

function.name: pmmvy_check_installment_status
function.description: Checks the approval stage of a specific installment inside the PMMVY system. Prerequisite: Must be called before pmmvy_raise_grievance for payment delay complaints — confirm the installment is actually pending before filing. Does NOT confirm actual bank credit via PFMS (use pmmvy_check_payment_status for that).

application_id.description:
PMMVY application ID generated at
    registration. Used for tracking and grievance tools.

installment_number.description: The specific installment number to check. 1 = pregnancy registration, 2 = ANC completion, 3 = child birth + first immunisation cycle.

function.name: pmmvy_track_grievance_status
function.description: Tracks the status of an existing grievance. Prerequisite: None. Does NOT raise a new grievance or check regular application status.

grievance_id.description: The ID of the previously submitted grievance.

function.name: pmmvy_update_mobile_number
function.description: Updates the registered mobile number of an existing beneficiary. Prerequisite: Requires a session_token from pmmvy_verify_beneficiary. Does NOT update bank details or other application data.

session_token.description:
Token returned by pmmvy_verify_beneficiary.
    Required for all authenticated tools. NOT required for
    the 6 public tools listed above.

application_id.description:
PMMVY application ID generated at
    registration. Used for tracking and grievance tools.

new_mobile_number.description: The new 10-digit mobile number to update.

function.name: pmmvy_verify_beneficiary
function.description: Authenticates the beneficiary via mobile OTP and returns a session_token. Prerequisite: None. Must be called before pmmvy_register_beneficiary, pmmvy_update_bank_details, pmmvy_update_mobile_number, and pmmvy_raise_grievance. Does NOT register the beneficiary.

mobile_number.description: The 10-digit mobile number of the beneficiary.

otp.description: The OTP received on the mobile number.

parallel_rationale: P1: pmmvy_check_installment_status for TWO different installment numbers
